name: GeigerMeasurement
description: Geiger-Müller counter measurement library for ESP32 and ESP8266. Implements the core measurement algorithms of the RadPro project (Gissio), adapted for the Arduino platform. Features five averaging modes, dead-time compensation, 95% confidence interval, in-situ dead-time measurement, live calibration, and fault detection.
keywords: geiger, radiation, dosimeter, measurement, ESP32, ESP8266, GM tube
